883: def _u11_unet_conditioning(cfg: Any, encoders: list) -> dict:
884:     """U11 compatibility conditioning from the DECLARED UNet config enums.
885: 
886:     This helper is unreachable from U10's source-projected denoiser path.  It is
887:     retained only behind a positively proven U-shaped root until U11 replaces
888:     the legacy UNet interpreter.
889: 
890:     The denoiser's conditioning story is resolved from
891:     (``encoder_hid_dim_type`` for the cross-attention K/V + its projector;
892:     ``addition_embed_type`` for the vector added to the timestep) plus the set of
893:     pipeline components that actually exist — never a hardcoded text assumption
894:     (F1).  An image-conditioned decoder (Kandinsky-2.2: ``image_proj``/``image``,
895:     no text encoder) is drawn as image conditioning, not a fabricated text tower.
896: 
897:     Resolution order for the cross-attention K/V modality:
898:       1. a declared, RECOGNISED ``encoder_hid_dim_type`` names the modality;
899:       2. a declared-but-unrecognised type -> honest-unknown (never text);
900:       3. no type declared but text encoders exist -> text (SDXL/PixArt today);
901:       4. nothing -> unknown.
902:     """
903:     vocab = load_unet_conditioning()
904:     enc_map = vocab["encoder_hid_dim_type"]
905:     add_map = vocab["addition_embed_type"]
906:     ehdt = _g(cfg, "encoder_hid_dim_type")
907:     aet = _g(cfg, "addition_embed_type")
908:     has_text = bool(encoders)
909:     out: dict = {
910:         "encoder_hid_dim_type": ehdt,
911:         "addition_embed_type": aet,
912:         "has_text_encoder": has_text,
913:     }
914:     kv = enc_map.get(str(ehdt)) if ehdt else None
915:     if kv:
916:         out["kv_modality"] = kv.get("modality")
917:         out["kv_label"] = kv.get("kv_label")
918:         out["projector"] = kv.get("projector")
919:         out["kv_text"] = bool(kv.get("text"))
920:     elif ehdt:                                   # declared but unmapped: honest-unknown
921:         out["kv_modality"] = "unknown"
922:         out["kv_label"] = "External conditioning"
923:         out["kv_text"] = False
924:     elif has_text:                               # conventional text conditioning
925:         out["kv_modality"] = "text"
926:         out["kv_label"] = "Encoded text"
927:         out["kv_text"] = True
928:     else:
929:         out["kv_modality"] = "unknown"
930:         out["kv_label"] = "External conditioning"
931:         out["kv_text"] = False

933:     if add:
934:         out["add_modality"] = add.get("modality")
935:         out["add_label"] = add.get("add_label")

292: def _unet_resnet_ops(act_label: str, act_note: str = "",
293:                      temporal: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
294:     """Cards for the ResNet residual cell.
295: 
296:     The real ResnetBlock2D.forward() is:
297:       norm1 + act → conv1 → (⊕ timestep emb) → norm2 + act → conv2 → (input ⊕ hidden)
298:     The residual bypass goes around the ENTIRE cell (from the block's raw input), not
299:     from norm1's output.  The timestep injection sits between conv1 and norm2.
300:     ``act_label``/``act_note`` come from the config's ``act_fn`` (a constructor
301:     record) with its provenance — the old hardcoded "SiLU" strings asserted the
302:     class default as if it were read.
303: 
304:     ``temporal`` (F3): a SpatioTemporalResBlock runs the spatial ResnetBlock2D
305:     above THEN a temporal 1-D-conv branch, then blends them with an AlphaBlender —
306:     the temporal ops a flat 2D drawing erases."""
307:     norm_desc = (f"Group normalization then a {act_label} activation, applied before "
308:                  "each convolution so the conv sees a well-scaled signal. GroupNorm "
309:                  f"is fixed in the ResnetBlock2D class; the activation is {act_note}.")
310:     conv_desc = ("A 3×3 convolution (stride 1, padding 1): mixes each position with its "
311:                  f"spatial neighbours — the cell runs GroupNorm+{act_label} → Conv 3×3 twice.")
312:     ops = [
313:         {"id": "unet_op_norm1", "title": f"GroupNorm + {act_label}", "description": norm_desc},
314:         {"id": "unet_op_conv1", "title": "Conv 3×3", "description": conv_desc},
315:         {"id": "unet_op_temb", "title": "⊕ Timestep embedding",
316:          "description": ("The linear-projected timestep embedding is added here "
317:                          f"(ResnetBlock2D: hidden_states = hidden_states + "
318:                          f"time_emb_proj({act_label}(temb))). "
319:                          "This is the mechanism by which a UNet ResNet receives the current noise "
320:                          "level — distinct from DiT/AdaLN, which gates normalization parameters. "
321:                          "The projection adjusts the channel width to match the residual branch.")},
322:         {"id": "unet_op_norm2", "title": f"GroupNorm + {act_label}", "description": norm_desc},
323:         {"id": "unet_op_conv2", "title": "Conv 3×3", "description": conv_desc},
324:         {"id": "unet_op_residual", "title": "Residual add",
325:          "description": ("Adds the block's raw input back onto the convolved output — "
326:                          "(input_tensor + hidden_states) / output_scale_factor. The bypass "
327:                          f"goes around the entire cell: norm1, {act_label}, conv1, "
328:                          f"timestep injection, norm2, {act_label}, conv2. When "
329:                          "in/out channels differ a 1×1 conv adjusts "
330:                          "the shortcut (conv_shortcut).")},
331:     ]

350: def _unet_transformer_subblocks(st: dict, cross_dim, prefix: str = "unet",
351:                                 ffn_act: str | None = None,
352:                                 kv_label: str | None = None,
353:                                 temporal: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
354:     """The three sub-blocks of a Transformer2D layer — each REUSES the canonical
355:     attention / feed-forward opener (the same view a transformer attention/FFN
356:     block opens), instead of a bespoke leaf.  Block ids are scoped by ``prefix``
357:     (the stage id) so a stage's heads/width survive the per-depth card dedup; the
358:     canonical attention opener stays shared.  Until U10 proves the exact UNet
359:     attention storage and score path, its internal projection/score details
360:     remain unresolved rather than being supplied by this view factory.
361: 
362:     ``kv_label`` (F1) is the resolved cross-attention K/V modality label — text
363:     ("Encoded text") for SD/SDXL, image ("Image embeds") for image_proj decoders
364:     (Kandinsky-2.2).  A text/None label keeps the exact prior text wording."""
365:     nh, hd, ch = st.get("num_heads"), st.get("head_dim"), st.get("channels")
366:     kv_text = kv_label is None or "text" in str(kv_label).lower()
367:     kv_name = "Encoded text" if kv_text else str(kv_label)
368:     kv_source = "encoded text prompt" if kv_text else str(kv_label).lower()
369:     kv_from = "text" if kv_text else str(kv_label)
370:     # ``attn_kind == transformer2d`` proves the enclosing cell and its
371:     # self/cross placement.  It does not prove the inner attention mechanism,
372:     # head sharing, projection storage, or score path.  U10 owns that reader.
373:     self_spec = AttentionSpec(

425: def unet_transformer_ffn_activation_from_files(files, declared_block_types) -> str | None:
426:     """The UNet Transformer2D FFN's activation, ANCHORED — or None.
427: 
428:     A Counter-vote across the import closure proves the WRONG family's
429:     activation (transformer_flux.py rides in via imports), so the read must be
430:     anchored to the blocks THIS config builds:
431: 
432:     1. the config's ``down/up/mid_block_types`` strings NAME the block classes
433:        (identity-as-ADDRESS — the lawful single use: a constructor record
434:        locating source, exactly like ``architectures``);
435:     2. BFS the CONSTRUCTION edges (field_types + sub_module_classes) from
436:        those classes;
437:     3. among reachable classes, the BLOCK-shaped ones (an attention-role AND
438:        an ffn-role field) yield their FFN construction's ``activation_fn``
439:        kwarg — literal, param-default, or IfExp constants;
440:     4. unanimous → the activation (SDXL: BasicTransformerBlock's default
441:        ``geglu``); mixed or empty → None (honest-undeclared, never a vote)."""
442:     import ast as _ast
443:     from .transitive import build_registry
444:     from .forward_ops import _method, _role_of
445:     from .vision import _class_node
446: 
447:     declared = [str(t) for t in (declared_block_types or ()) if t]
448:     if not declared or not files:
449:         return None
450:     registry = build_registry([str(f) for f in files])
451:     seen = {t for t in declared if t in registry}
452:     queue = list(seen)
453:     while queue:
454:         info = registry.get(queue.pop(0))
455:         if info is None:
456:             continue
457:         kids = set((info.field_types or {}).values())
458:         for elems in (info.sub_module_classes or {}).values():
459:             kids |= set(elems)
460:         for child in kids:
461:             if child in registry and child not in seen:
462:                 seen.add(child)
463:                 queue.append(child)
464:     verdicts: set[str] = set()
465:     for cls in sorted(seen):
466:         fields = (registry[cls].field_types or {}).values()
467:         if not (any(_role_of(x) == "attention" for x in fields)
468:                 and any(_role_of(x) == "ffn" for x in fields)):
469:             continue
470:         node = _class_node(registry[cls].source_file, cls)
471:         init = _method(node, "__init__") if node else None
472:         if init is None:
473:             continue
474:         defaults = {a.arg: d.value for a, d in
475:                     zip(init.args.args[::-1], (init.args.defaults or [])[::-1])
476:                     if isinstance(d, _ast.Constant) and isinstance(d.value, str)}
477:         for n in _ast.walk(init):

479:                 continue
480:             for kw in (n.keywords or []):
481:                 if kw.arg != "activation_fn":
482:                     continue
483:                 v = kw.value
484:                 if isinstance(v, _ast.Constant) and isinstance(v.value, str):
485:                     verdicts.add(v.value.lower())
486:                 elif isinstance(v, _ast.Name) and v.id in defaults:
487:                     verdicts.add(defaults[v.id].lower())
488:                 elif isinstance(v, _ast.IfExp):
489:                     for sub in (v.body, v.orelse):
490:                         if isinstance(sub, _ast.Constant) and isinstance(sub.value, str):
491:                             verdicts.add(sub.value.lower())
492:     return next(iter(verdicts)) if len(verdicts) == 1 else None

667: def build_unet_resnet_view(ir: dict, info: dict, mount_id: str, block: dict) -> str:
668:     """One ResNet block — the actual ResnetBlock2D.forward() cell:
669:     in → GroupNorm+activation → Conv 3×3 → ⊕ timestep emb →
670:     GroupNorm+activation → Conv 3×3 → ⊕ → out.
671: 
672:     The residual bypass (shortcut) goes around the ENTIRE cell from the raw block
673:     input — not from norm1.  The timestep embedding is injected between conv1 and
674:     norm2 (the UNet's conditioning mechanism, as distinct from DiT/AdaLN).
675:     The activation label is projected from the canonical child card; this renderer
676:     never supplies a SiLU/GELU mechanism default."""
677:     d = block.get("detail") or {}
678:     ch = d.get("channels")
679:     temporal = bool(d.get("temporal"))
680:     child_by_id = {
681:         child.get("id"): child
682:         for child in (block.get("children") or [])
683:         if isinstance(child, dict)
684:     }
685:     norm_activation = str(
686:         (child_by_id.get("unet_op_norm1") or {}).get("title")
687:         or "GroupNorm + Activation"
688:     )
689:     op = {"w": 216, "h": 44}
690:     # A ResNet block is ONE residual cell, not a repeated stack (the per-stage
691:     # repeat = layers_per_block is shown one level up, on the stage). So its ops
692:     # are ``pre`` (a plain chain + residual loop), never a "× N" repeat-frame.
693:     # residual_from "unet_res_in" (the block's input port): the shortcut bypasses
694:     # norm1 + activation + conv1 + temb_inject + norm2 + activation + conv2.
695:     # F3: a spatio-temporal block appends the temporal 1-D-conv branch + AlphaBlender.
696:     pre = [
697:         {"id": "unet_op_norm1", "kind": "norm",
698:          "label": norm_activation, **op},
699:         {"id": "unet_op_conv1", "kind": "embedding", "label": "Conv 3×3", **op},
700:         {"id": "unet_op_temb", "kind": "residual_add", "label": "⊕ Timestep emb"},
701:         {"id": "unet_op_norm2", "kind": "norm",
702:          "label": norm_activation, **op},
703:         {"id": "unet_op_conv2", "kind": "embedding", "label": "Conv 3×3", **op},
704:         {"id": "unet_op_residual", "kind": "residual_add", "residual_from": "unet_res_in"},
705:     ]
706:     if temporal:
707:         pre += [
708:             {"id": "unet_op_temporal", "kind": "embedding", "label": "Temporal conv",
709:              "sub": "1-D over frames", **op},
710:             {"id": "unet_op_alphablend", "kind": "residual_add", "label": "α AlphaBlender"},
711:         ]
712:     graph = tower_graph({
713:         "source": {"id": "unet_res_in", "label": f"in ({ch:,} ch)" if ch else "in"},
714:         "pre": pre,
715:         "output": {"id": "unet_res_out"},
716:         # The projected timestep embedding enters beside the injection node.
717:         "side_inputs": [{
718:             "node": {"id": "unet_res_temb", "kind": "source",
719:                      "label": "Timestep emb", "w": 148},
720:             "target": "unet_op_temb",
721:         }],
722:     })
723:     return render_graph(graph, info, mount_id, f"unetres_{block.get('id') or 'x'}",
724:                         f"{ir.get('name', 'model')} ResNet block", min_width=540)
